documents.name: claim_water_damage_001.txt
documents.text: Insurance claim CLM-1041. Policyholder: Harbor Dental. Loss date: March 4. Reported date: March 22. The claim describes water damage from a failed pipe in the sterilization room. The adjuster notes missing photos of damaged equipment, no plumber invoice, and a late submission beyond the 10 day notice window. Estimated claimed loss is $42,000. Coverage cannot be confirmed until documentation is supplied.

documents.name: change_order_001.txt
documents.text: Construction change order CO-17 for the North Pier tenant buildout. Requested by field superintendent on May 9. Scope adds fire-rated glass partitions and weekend electrical labor. Original contract amount was $480,000. Added material cost is $11,200 and added labor cost is $7,300. Total cost increase is $18,500. Schedule impact is three days. Owner approval is required before work proceeds.

documents.name: invoice_cloud_services_001.txt
documents.text: Invoice INV-8831 from CloudMetric Labs to Lumen Retail. Billing period: April 1 to April 30. Amount due is $9,840. Purchase order PO-4482 is present. The invoice matches the contracted monthly monitoring fee and includes no overage charges. Payment terms are net 30. Finance note: approve if department code 612 is still active.

documents.name: contract_vendor_001.txt
documents.text: Vendor services agreement with BrightDesk Support. Effective date: June 1. The contract auto-renews annually unless either party gives 60 days notice. Liability is capped at fees paid in the prior three months. Data processing addendum is missing. Security exhibit references SOC 2 but no current report is attached. Legal should create a task to obtain missing security documents before signature.

documents.name: compliance_note_privacy_001.txt
documents.text: Compliance review note CR-221. A marketing export included customer email addresses and purchase history. The export was shared with an external analytics vendor before vendor approval was completed. The note flags possible privacy policy breach and missing data processing agreement. Compliance owner recommends escalation for privacy review within two business days.

documents.name: claim_roof_hail_002.txt
documents.text: Insurance claim CLM-1099. Property: Westbrook Storage. Reported hail damage to roof panels. Loss date: April 12. Reported date: April 14. Photos, weather report, and contractor estimate are attached. Claimed repair amount is $31,750. No prior roof exclusion appears in the policy file. Adjuster note: documentation is complete and no immediate risk is identified.

documents.name: change_order_foundation_002.txt
documents.text: Change order CO-24 for the civic center foundation package. Geotechnical memo found unsuitable soil below gridline C. Contractor proposes undercutting, disposal, and imported structural fill. Added cost is $64,900. Schedule impact is twelve days. The change exceeds the $50,000 delegated approval threshold and should be flagged as a cost risk.

documents.name: invoice_facilities_002.txt
documents.text: Invoice INV-2044 from Metro Facilities. Amount due is $14,260 for after-hours HVAC repair. Purchase order is missing. The service ticket was approved by operations, but the invoice includes an unexplained emergency fee of $1,800. Accounts payable should request more information before approval.

documents.name: contract_lease_002.txt
documents.text: Office lease amendment for Suite 410. The amendment extends the term by 24 months and increases monthly rent to $22,500 starting September 1. It also adds a restoration obligation at tenant expense. The insurance certificate is expired. Create a task for legal operations to collect updated insurance evidence.

documents.name: compliance_note_training_002.txt
documents.text: Compliance note CR-238. Quarterly AML training completion is 96 percent. Four contractors have not completed the module by the deadline. No customer impact is noted. The compliance team recommends creating a task for contractor follow-up and weekly completion tracking.

documents.name: claim_theft_003.txt
documents.text: Insurance claim CLM-1120 for retail inventory theft. Police report number is listed as pending. Inventory spreadsheet is attached, but proof of purchase is missing for high-value tablets. Loss was reported 18 days after discovery. Claimed amount is $27,400. Adjuster should request more information on proof of purchase and police report status.

documents.name: change_order_paint_003.txt
documents.text: Change order CO-31 for classroom repainting. Owner requested color change after mockup review. Added paint material is $2,600 and added labor is $3,900. Total cost increase is $6,500. No schedule impact. The amount is within project manager approval authority.

documents.name: invoice_legal_003.txt
documents.text: Invoice INV-5520 from Benton Legal. Amount due is $18,750 for contract review and employment advisory work. Matter IDs are present. The invoice exceeds the monthly legal budget by $4,250 and includes partner review time not listed in the engagement letter. Finance should flag risk for budget overage review.

documents.name: contract_supplier_003.txt
documents.text: Supply agreement with Northline Plastics. Minimum purchase commitment is 40,000 units per quarter. Termination for convenience requires 90 days notice. The draft lacks a price adjustment cap and does not include audit rights. Procurement should create a task to revise commercial protections before approval.

documents.name: compliance_note_safety_003.txt
documents.text: Safety compliance note SF-19. Warehouse inspection found blocked emergency exit access and missing forklift inspection logs. The supervisor corrected the blocked exit during inspection, but logs remain missing for two vehicles. Escalate compliance review because inspection evidence is incomplete.

documents.name: claim_business_interruption_004.txt
documents.text: Business interruption claim CLM-1184. Cafe closure lasted five days after a nearby electrical fire. The policyholder submitted sales history and utility outage confirmation. The claim lacks payroll records for the closure period. Estimated loss is $16,200. Request more information for payroll records.

documents.name: change_order_mechanical_004.txt
documents.text: Mechanical change order CO-40. Engineer revised duct routing to avoid an existing beam. Added sheet metal is $8,450 and added coordination labor is $5,550. Total cost increase is $14,000. Schedule impact is one day. The change should be tracked but does not exceed risk threshold.

documents.name: invoice_security_004.txt
documents.text: Invoice INV-7441 from Shield Security. Amount due is $6,300 for monthly monitoring. Purchase order PO-7780 is present, rate matches the master service agreement, and no exception fees are included. Operations confirmed service completion. Approve invoice for payment.

documents.name: contract_dpa_004.txt
documents.text: Data processing addendum for Atlas Insights. The vendor will process customer identifiers and behavioral analytics. Subprocessor list is attached. The breach notification period is 10 business days, longer than company policy of 72 hours. Escalate compliance review before signing.

documents.name: compliance_note_access_004.txt
documents.text: Access review AR-77. Three former contractors still had active dashboard accounts after termination. Access was disabled during review. The manager approval trail is missing for two privileged roles. Create a task to document approvals and verify offboarding controls.
